code_change.notes: Code changes often benefit from focused execution and regression validation rather than maximum test breadth.

research_answer.notes: Research answers benefit from source agreement and freshness-sensitive validation.

automation_flow.notes: Automation work benefits from testing the real flow and verifying actual outcomes.

refactor_repair.preferred_validation_shape: before/after behavior confidence plus targeted regression checks
refactor_repair.notes: Repairs benefit from proving the fix and guarding nearby behavior.
